title: Part (2 parts)
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system for the first part, setting the Euler angles to [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and the translation vector to [0.0, 0.0, 0.0153]. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. In this face, draw a single loop consisting of one circle centered at [0.0077, 0.0077] with a radius of 0.0077. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0153 to the sketch to adjust its size. Transform the sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0153]. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.7347 units to create a new solid body. The resulting shape is a cylindrical object with a small, rounded top and a thin, elongated body. The dimensions are length = 0.015306122448979591, width = 0.015306122448979591, and height = 0.7346938775510204. For the second part, create another coordinate system with Euler angles set to [0.0, 0.0, 180.0] and the translation vector to [0.0026, 0.0128, 0.0153]. Draw a new two-dimensional sketch on a new face, consisting of a single loop with one circle centered at [0.0051, 0.0051] and a radius of 0.0051. Scale the sketch by a factor of 0.0102. Transform the sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 180.0] and translating it using the vector [0.0026, 0.0128, 0.0153]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.0153 units to create a new solid body that joins the existing body. The second shape is a cylindrical object with a smooth surface and rounded edges, with dimensions length = 0.01020408163265306, width = 0.01020408163265306, and height = 0.015306122448979591.

import cadquery as cq

# Define the first part
part_1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0077, 0.0077)
    .circle(0.0077)
    .extrude(0.7347)
    .translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.0153))
)

# Define the second part
part_2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0051, 0.0051)
    .circle(0.0051)
    .extrude(0.0153)
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 180)
    .translate((0.0026, 0.0128, 0.0153))
)

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.union(part_2)

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: Create the cylindrical rod
cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0077, 0.0077)
    .circle(0.0077)
    .extrude(0.7347)
    .translate((0.0077, 0.0, 0.0))
)

# Part 2: Create the rectangular section at the top
rect = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0154, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0154, 0.0154)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0154)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0154)
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -90)
    .translate((0.0, 0.0077, 0.0))
)

# Part 3: Create the small cylindrical cutout
cutout = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0039, 0.0039)
    .circle(0.0039)
    .extrude(0.0154)
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -90)
    .translate((0.0039, 0.0039, 0.0))
)

# Combine the parts
r = cylinder.union(rect).cut(cutout)

import cadquery as cq

# Main vertical rod: circular cross-section, diameter 0.0154, height 0.7347
main_rod = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0.0153, 0.0077, 0.0))
    .circle(0.0077)
    .extrude(0.7347)
)

# Small cylindrical nub protruding in -X near the bottom
nub = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0.0025, 0.0077, 0.0025))
    .circle(0.0025)
    .extrude(0.0100)
)

# Combine into a single solid
r = main_rod.union(nub)
